blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型联合学习机器人政策并预测未来的观测结果,使表现空间成为控制与预测的界面. 我们通过有控制的比较来研究这一空间的设计,发现无论是重建忠贞性还是预先受过训练的感官特征,都不能确保有效的政策学习。 这些调查结果激励了REWAM,这是一种以代表性为中心的世界行动模式,它建立在事先经过培训的DINO特征上。 特征校准和瞬间代表 Bottleneck 将这些特征组织成适合动态建模的紧凑世界国家. 环绕行动代表制将行动损失梯度推向瓶颈,从而使政策形成代表制编码,而世界模式则学习如何演变。 没有基因视频预训,REWAM在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了93.6%的成功. 在RoboDojo上,它使用约600小时的内含的训练前数据,取得了平均12.29分和8.28%的成功率.

blocks.en: \calmregular Introduction
blocks.zh: 调谐 导言

blocks.en: World-action models (WAMs) jointly learn robot policies and predict how the world evolves. Many recent WAMs ( Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Ye et al., 2026c ; Yuan et al., 2026b ) build on pre-trained video generators and predict future observations in the latent space of a video variational autoencoder (Video-VAE). These models inherit dynamics priors from large-scale generative video pre-training, but their latent spaces are typically optimized for visual reconstruction. Such spaces may preserve fine-grained appearance details without explicitly prioritizing information relevant to control.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型(WAMs)联合学习机器人政策并预测世界如何演变. 许多最近的WAM(Bi等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年b;Ye等人,2026年c;Yuan等人,2026年b)利用经过预先训练的视频生成器,预测未来在视频变异自编码器(Video-VAE)潜在空间的观测结果. 这些模型继承了大规模基因视频预训的动态前传,但其潜伏空间一般被优化用于视觉重建. 这种空间可能保留精细的外观细节,而不明确确定与控制有关的信息的优先次序。

blocks.en: The role of world prediction extends beyond producing explicit visual rollouts. Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) retains video co-training while removing future-video denoising at deployment, suggesting that prediction can benefit policies through joint training. This raises a fundamental question: How should the representation space for world-action modeling be defined?
blocks.zh: 世界预测的作用超越了产生清晰的视觉推广. 快速WAM( 快速WAM ) (Yuan等人,2026b)保留视频协同训练,同时取消未来视频在部署时的代名词,暗示预测可以通过联合训练使政策受益. 这提出了一个根本问题: 应当如何界定世界行动模式的代表空间?

blocks.en: Representation-space WAMs use pre-trained perceptual features or learned visual-action tokenizers ( Lyu et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Comparative studies show that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient to assess control utility ( Nilaksh et al., 2026 ; Yeom et al., 2026 ) . Our experiments support this distinction: without generative video pre-training, raw DINO features outperform Video-VAE latents on RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , despite lower pixel-reconstruction SSIM. Reconstruction-oriented latents therefore do not by themselves establish effective representations for policy learning.
blocks.zh: 表示空间 WAMs使用经过预训的知觉特征或学习的视觉动作示意器(Lyu等人,2026年;Deng等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年). 比较研究表明,仅靠重建忠诚不足以评估控制效用(Nilaksh等人,2026年;Yeom等人,2026年)。 我们的实验支持这种区别:没有基因视频预训,原始的DINO特性在RoboTwin 2.0(Chen等人,2025年)上的Video-VAE潜质就超过,尽管像素重建的SSIM较低。 因此,以重建为导向的潜在因素本身并不能有效体现政策学习。

blocks.en: Perceptual features are also not necessarily well suited to dynamics modeling: frame-wise features do not explicitly encode temporal variation, and their statistics may be poorly matched to diffusion training. Calibrating DINO features through multi-layer aggregation, normalization, and a representation-aware diffusion noise schedule improves average success on RoboTwin 2.0 by 12.20 12.20 percentage points. Representation design thus extends beyond the choice of encoder. It must also address how features are prepared for prediction, organized over time, and adapted to the needs of control.
blocks.zh: 概念性特征也不一定非常适合动态建模:帧性特征没有明确编码时间差异,其统计可能与传播培训不匹配. 通过多层次的聚合,正常化,以及能感知到的传播噪声时间表来校准DINO特征,使RoboTwin 2.0的平均成功率提高了12.20 12.20个百分点. 因此,代表设计超出了编码器的选择范围。 它还必须解决如何为预测准备特征,并随着时间的推移加以组织,并适应控制的需要。

blocks.en: We propose a division of roles: the policy shapes what the representation encodes, while the world model learns how that representation evolves. We introduce ReWAM , a representation-centric WAM that implements this principle through Action-Grounded Representation Shaping (AGRS). Feature Calibration prepares frozen DINO features for diffusion modeling, and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck (TRB) organizes them into compact world states. During joint training, AGRS routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, adapting the representation to action prediction. The world model learns how this representation evolves without updating it through its own prediction loss. Fig. 1 provides an overview of ReWAM.
blocks.zh: 我们提出分工:政策决定了代表的编码,而世界模式则了解这种代表如何演变。 我们引入了REWAM,这是一个以代表性为中心的WAM,它通过 " 整体行动代表性 " (AGRS)执行这一原则。 特性校准准备用于传播模型的冷冻DINO特性,一个Tempolar Dational Bottleneck(TRB)将它们组织成紧凑的世界国家。 在联合培训期间,AGRS只将行动损失梯度引向瓶颈,使表述方式适应行动预测。 世界模型在不通过自己的预测损失来更新的情况下,学会了这种表现如何演变. 图1概述了REWAM。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of representations for world-action modeling. Top-left: Video-VAE latents are optimized for visual reconstruction. Top-right: Frozen DINO features inherit priors from perceptual pre-training. Bottom: ReWAM uses a Temporal Representation Bottleneck (TRB) to form compact world states from calibrated DINO features. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping (AGRS) trains the TRB through asymmetric routing of action-loss gradients, while the world model learns state transitions.
blocks.zh: 图1:世界行动模式表述概览。 左上角:Video-VAE潜伏优化用于视觉重建. 右上方:冰冻的DINO特征继承了感知前训练的前身. 底部:ReWAM使用Tempolar Presentation Bottleneck(TRB)从校准的DINO特性形成紧凑的世界态. 动作全方位代表形状(AGRS)通过动作损失梯度的不对称路径来训练TRB,而世界模式则学习状态过渡.

blocks.en: Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success in both the clean and random settings of RoboTwin 2.0 and leads the compared methods without embodied pre-training on RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . Embodied pre-training further improves its RoboDojo average score to 12.29 and success rate to 8.28%. Together with real-robot evaluations, these findings highlight a promising path for world-action modeling based on pre-trained perceptual priors and representations shaped by the demands of control, without relying on generative video pre-training.
blocks.zh: 在没有基因视频预训的情况下,REWAM在RoboTwin 2.0的清洁和随机设置上都取得了93.6%的成功,并在没有体现对RoboDojo的预训的情况下领导了比较方法(Chen等人,2026年b). 健美的预训进一步提高了RoboDojo的平均成绩,达到12.29分,成功率达到8.28%. 这些结论与实际机器人评价一起,突出了基于预先受过训练的感知前科和由控制需求所塑造的表达方式的世界行动模式的一条有希望的道路,而不依赖于基因视频预训.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面:

blocks.en: • We show through controlled comparisons that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient for choosing WAM representations, and that perceptual features benefit from calibration for dynamics modeling. • We introduce ReWAM, which lets the action objective shape a compact representation space for joint prediction and control. • We demonstrate the effectiveness of this design without generative video pre-training across two simulation benchmarks and real-robot tasks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们通过有控制的比较表明,仅靠重建忠心不足以选择WAM的表示,而且知觉特征得益于动态模型的校准。 我们介绍了REWAM,它使行动目标能够形成一个紧凑的表示空间,以便共同预测和控制。 我们通过两个模拟基准和真机器人任务,在不进行基因视频预训的情况下展示这种设计的有效性.

blocks.en: We show through controlled comparisons that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient for choosing WAM representations, and that perceptual features benefit from calibration for dynamics modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们通过有控制的比较表明,仅靠重建忠心不足以选择WAM的表示,而知觉特征则得益于动态模型的校准。

blocks.en: We introduce ReWAM, which lets the action objective shape a compact representation space for joint prediction and control.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了REWAM,它让行动目标形成一个紧凑的表示空间,用于联合预测和控制.

blocks.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness of this design without generative video pre-training across two simulation benchmarks and real-robot tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个模拟基准和真机器人任务,在不进行基因视频预训的情况下展示这种设计的有效性.

blocks.en: \calmregular Related Work
blocks.zh: 调谐 有关工作

blocks.en: \calmregular World-Action Models
blocks.zh: 调谐 世界行动模式

blocks.en: Unified video and action models couple dynamics prediction with policy learning ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . Recent systems build on video generation through joint denoising ( Ye et al., 2026c ) or interactions between world and action streams ( Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Motubrain Team et al., 2026 ) . RxBrain ( Liang et al., 2026 ) and Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) extend this framework to broader multimodal understanding and generation.
blocks.zh: 统一的视频和行动模型将动态预测与政策学习结合起来(Zhu等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年b)。 近期的系统通过联合代名词(Ye等人,2026c)或世界与动作流之间的互动(Bi等人,2026年;Li等人,2026b;Motubrain Team等人,2026年)为基础生成视频. RxBrain (Liang et al., 2026)和Cosmos 3(NVIDIA, 2026)将这个框架扩展到更广泛的多式联运理解和生成.

blocks.en: Other approaches expose intermediate generative features to the policy ( Pai et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026d ) . Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) removes future-video denoising at deployment, while Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) studies sparse interactions between video and action prediction under distribution shift. These studies motivate examining how the shared representation interface supports policy learning. Complementary work enriches visual prediction with geometric, motion, and semantic supervision ( Guo et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026c ; Yuan et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026a ) , or aligns policy features with future visual representations ( Zheng et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 其他方法将中间基因特征暴露在该政策中(Pai等人,2026年;Ma等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年d). 快速WAM( 快速WAM ) (Yuan et al., 2026b)在部署时删除了未来-视频代名词,而Seaster-WAM(Zhao et al., 2026b)则在发行转移时研究视频与动作预测之间的零散互动. 这些研究促使审查共享代表界面如何支持政策学习。 补充工作通过几何、运动和语义监督丰富视觉预测(Guo等人,2026a); Li等人,2026c;Yuan等人,2026a;Li等人,2026a),或将政策特征与未来的视觉表现相协调(郑等人,2025b;赵等人,2026a).

blocks.en: Representation-space approaches use pre-trained visual features for prediction and control. LDA-1B ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) and DexWorldModel ( Deng et al., 2026 ) directly predict DINO features, while VLA-JEPA ( Sun et al., 2026 ) and Being-H0.7 ( Luo et al., 2026 ) use future observations to supervise latent representations that guide action generation. LaWAM ( Chen et al., 2026a ) predicts latent visual subgoals, and GAM ( Han et al., 2026 ) uses geometric foundation features for prediction and action decoding. Learned visual-action tokenizers adapt the interface between perception and control ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , while residual latent actions model changes in DINO features ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . ReWAM builds on this line of work by calibrating and temporally organizing pre-trained features, then using asymmetric gradient routing to adapt the prediction space to the policy objective during joint world-action training.
blocks.zh: 表示空间方法利用预先训练的视觉特征进行预测和控制。 LDA-1B(Lyu等人,2026年)和DexWorldModel(Deng等人,2026年)直接预测DINO特征,而VLA-JEPA(Sun等人,2026年)和Being-H0.7(Luo等人,2026年)则利用未来的观测来监督引导行动生成的潜在表达. LaWAM(Chen等人,2026a)预测潜在的视觉次级目标,GAM(Han等人,2026年)使用几何基础特征进行预测和动作解码. 所学视觉动作符号器适应感知和控制的界面(Wang等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年b; Yang et al., 2026),而DINO特征的残余潜伏动作模型变化(Zhang et al., 2026c). REWAM通过校准并按时间组织预先训练的特征,然后利用不对称梯度路由,使预测空间适应世界联合行动训练期间的政策目标,以此为基础.

blocks.en: \calmregular Representations for Prediction and Generation
blocks.zh: 调谐 预测和生成说明

blocks.en: Predictive learning in visual feature spaces supports representation learning and world modeling, as explored by V-JEPA models ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , DINO-world ( Baldassarre et al., 2025 ) , and Spa3R ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: V-JEPA模型(Asran等人,2025年;Mur-Labadia等人,2026年),DINO-world(Baldassarre等人,2025年)和Spa3R(Jiang等人,2026年)探讨了视觉特征空间的预测性学习支持代表学习和世界建模。

blocks.en: Representation design also matters for generation. REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Leng et al., 2025 ) and VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) align denoiser features and autoencoder latents, respectively, with pre-trained representations. The representation autoencoder (RAE) ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) uses pre-trained encoders to define generative latent spaces, with subsequent work extending this approach to video generation ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026b ) and interactive world modeling ( Hu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 代表设计对一代人也很重要。 REPA(Yu等人,2025年;Leng等人,2025年)和VA-VAE(Yao等人,2025年)分别将denoiser特性和自动编码潜伏物与训练有素的表示物相配合。 代表自动编码器(RAE)(郑等人,2026年;辛格等人,2026年)使用预训编码器定义基因潜伏空间,随后的工作将这种方法推广到视频生成(谢等人,2026年;郭等人,2026年b)和互动世界模型(胡等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Probing studies and comparative analyses examine what representations encode and how they support spatial understanding, dynamics prediction, and control ( Huang et al., 2026b ; Yeom et al., 2026 ; Nilaksh et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . ReWAM addresses the complementary problem of how to construct and adapt a representation space for joint world prediction and policy learning.

blocks.zh: 调谐 特性校准

blocks.en: \calmregular Setup
blocks.zh: 调谐 设置

blocks.en: ReWAM uses frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) features and UMT5 embeddings of language instructions. The world and action DiT branches each contain 30 layers, with hidden widths of 2048 2048 and 1024 1024 , respectively, and approximately 3.58B parameters in total. Head-camera images are resized to 256 × 320 256\times 320 pixels and wrist-camera images to 128 × 160 128\times 160 pixels. Actions and proprioception are represented as 14-dimensional joint-and-gripper vectors and standardized using z-score normalization. We train with AdamW on 32 H20 GPUs, with a batch size of 512 and a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} that decays to 10 − 6 10^{-6} on a cosine schedule.
blocks.zh: ReWAM使用冷冻的DINov3 VIT-L/16(Siméoni等人,2026年)功能和UMT5嵌入语言指令. 世界和动作DiT分支各包含30层,隐藏宽度分别为2048 2048和1024 1024,总参数约为3.58B. 头摄像头图像的大小调整为256×320 256\times 320像素和腕摄像头图像的大小调整为128×160 128\times 160像素. 动作和自主性作为14维的联动和引力矢量来表示,并使用z分数的正常化进行标准化. 我们和AdamW一起在32个H20 GPU上训练, 批量大小为512, 最高学习速率为10 - 4 10 - 4 10 - 4}, 衰落到10 - 6 10 - 6 6} 在大同时间表上。

blocks.en: We train a multi-task policy on the 50-task RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark ( Chen et al., 2025 ) using 2,500 clean trajectories and 25,000 trajectories from the random setting. The main comparison uses five training epochs, aligned with the baseline protocol. Representation comparisons and ablations, including the Fast-WAM baselines, use a matched one-epoch training budget. We evaluate 100 episodes per task in each of the clean and random settings and average success rates across tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们用2500条干净的轨迹和25000条随机设定的轨迹,在50个任务RoboTwin 2.0基准(Chen等人,2025年)上开展一项多任务政策. 主要比较采用五个训练时代,与基线协议一致. 代表性比较和模拟,包括快速WAM基线,使用相应的一次性培训预算。 我们评价每个任务在干净和随机设置中的100集和各项任务的平均成功率。

blocks.en: We evaluate on the simulation suite of RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , which covers five capability categories: Generalization, Precision, Long-Horizon, Memory, and Open. The training set contains 3,500 trajectories across 35 tasks. We train ReWAM for 50k steps with and without prior embodied pre-training. We report the benchmark’s partial-progress score and binary success rate, averaging each metric across the five categories and comparing methods within each pre-training setting.
blocks.zh: 我们评价RoboDojo的模拟套件(Chen等人,2026年b),它包括五个能力类别:通用、精密、长视、记忆和开放。 该培训集包含3 500个轨迹,涉及35项任务。 我们训练REWAM50公里的步数,无论是否事先包含预先训练。 我们报告基准的半进度分数和二进制成功率,在五个类别中平均为每个衡量标准,并在每个培训前环境下比较方法。

blocks.en: To assess the benefit of embodied pre-training with additional data, we pre-train ReWAM and Fast-WAM for 75k steps on the same 600 hours of self-collected real-robot manipulation demonstrations. The dataset covers a broad range of manipulation tasks, with collection environments and camera settings that differ from those used in our downstream real-robot experiments.
blocks.zh: 为了评估包含在附加数据中的预训的好处,我们预训REWAM和Fast-WAM在同样600小时的自收集实机器人操纵演示上共75k步. 数据集涵盖广泛的操纵任务,其采集环境和相机设置与我们下游真机器人实验中使用的环境不同.

blocks.en: We evaluate ReWAM on a bimanual Piper platform across three tasks: Collect Objects, Fold Clothes, and Unpack Lunchbox. After embodied pre-training, ReWAM and Fast-WAM each undergo 10k steps of task-specific post-training on demonstrations collected in the target scene. We report success rates over 20 trials per task.
blocks.zh: 我们在双人管道平台上对REWAM进行评估,它涉及三项任务:收集物品、粗体衣服和Unpack午餐盒。 在包含培训前内容之后,REWAM和Fast-WAM各自在目标场景收集的针对特定任务的示威后培训中进行10千步. 我们报告每个任务的成功率超过20次。

blocks.en: \calmregular Main Results
blocks.zh: 调谐 主要成果

blocks.en: ReWAM achieves 93.6% success in both settings of RoboTwin 2.0 ( sec. 3.4 ), exceeding the strongest compared method by 0.2 0.2 percentage points on clean and 1.4 1.4 points on random. Its performance in the random setting indicates robustness to the benchmark’s scene variations without embodied pre-training.
blocks.zh: REWAM实现 在RoboTwin 2.0(第3.4秒)的两种设置中,成功率93.6%,比最强的比法在清洁上高出0.2个百分点,在随机上超过1.41.4个百分点. 其随机设定的性能表明基准场景变化的稳健性,而没有体现培训前的特征。

blocks.en: On RoboDojo, ReWAM leads the compared methods without embodied pre-training, with an average score of 9.42 9.42 and a success rate of 5.82 % 5.82\% ( sec. 3.4 ). Embodied pre-training raises these results to 12.29 12.29 and 8.28 % 8.28\% , highlighting ReWAM’s potential to improve further with larger-scale embodied training data. In this setting, ReWAM achieves the highest Generalization score and success rate and the highest Long-Horizon success rate.
blocks.zh: 在机器人上 Dojo,REWAM在未包含预训内容的情况下领先比较方法,平均得分为9.42 9.42,成功率为5.82%5.82\%(第3.4秒). 健康的培训预科将结果提高到12.29 12.29 和8.28% 8.28%,突出显示妇女、妇女和儿童事务局利用更大规模的培训数据进一步改进的潜力。 在这一背景下,REWAM实现了最高的通化分数和成功率,以及最高的Long-Horizon成功率.

blocks.en: The benefits of embodied pre-training vary across capabilities. Generalization and Long-Horizon success rates rise from 4.33 % 4.33\% to 10.50 % 10.50\% and from 11.00 % 11.00\% to 16.25 % 16.25\% , respectively. ReWAM remains competitive on Precision tasks without explicit geometric enhancements, though it trails geometry-enhanced methods such as X-VLA Zheng et al. (2025a) and Spatial Forcing Li et al. (2025a) . ReWAM also falls substantially behind the leading methods in Open instruction following. We attribute the gap in open instruction following to the absence of generative video pre-training, which limits instruction generalization.
blocks.zh: 体现的培训前的好处因能力而异。 一般化和长视的成功率分别从4.33%(4.33%)上升到10.50%(10.50%)和11.0%(11.0%)上升到16.25%(16.25%)。 REWAM在精密任务上仍然具有竞争力,没有明显的几何增强,尽管它跟随了X-VLA Zheng等人(2025a)和Space Forcing Li等人(2025a)等几何增强方法. REWAM也大大落后于以下开放教学的主要方法。 我们把开放教学的空白归因于缺乏基因视频预训,这限制了教学的普及。

blocks.en: Progressively calibrating DINO features with normalization, a representation-aware noise schedule, and multi-layer aggregation yields successive gains of 3.92 3.92 , 1.41 1.41 , and 6.87 6.87 percentage points in average success, as detailed in tab. 6 . Together, these components improve average success by 12.20 12.20 points over raw DINO features. The gains indicate that pre-trained perceptual features benefit from calibration to the distribution and structure required by diffusion-based dynamics modeling.

blocks.en: To assess temporal organization, we compare the representation designs in tab. 6 . Fixed random projection concatenates features at each spatial location across a temporal window and projects them to 512 512 dimensions. This simple construction improves average success by 2.89 2.89 percentage points over the calibrated frame-wise baseline, highlighting the value of temporal organization. The result is consistent with prior work on fixed random projections of pre-trained DINO features as prediction latents ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . We also pre-train the TRB as a codec to reconstruct RGB images or DINO features and freeze it during WAM training. The RGB reconstruction codec substantially reduces success, whereas the DINO reconstruction codec falls slightly below fixed random projection on average, suggesting that reconstruction-based training alone is insufficient to improve these temporal representations for control.
blocks.zh: 为了评估时间组织,我们用标签来比较表述设计。 6. 固定随机投影通过一个时间窗口对每个空间位置的特征进行压缩,并投影到512 512维. 这种简单的构筑比校准框架基线提高了2.89 2.89个百分点,突出了时间组织的价值。 该结果与先前关于预先训练的DINO特征作为预测潜伏物的固定随机预测(Hu等人,2026年)相一致。 我们还对TRB进行预训,作为重建RGB图像或DINO特性的编码器,并在WAM训练期间将其冻结. RGB重建编码大大降低了成功率,而DINO重建编码则平均略低于固定的随机预测,这表明仅基于重建的培训不足以改善这些用于控制的时间表示.

blocks.en:
AGRS achieves 90.70 % / 89.12 % 90.70\%/89.12\% success on clean/random, outperforming fixed random projection by 3.94 / 3.18 3.94/3.18 percentage points in tab. 6 . blocks.en: We investigate the action-related structure in ReWAM and Video-VAE representations using t-SNE and nearest-neighbor direction agreement. Fig. 3 (a) shows independent t-SNE projections of commanded end-effector trajectories and representation variations for the same transitions: one from each of 242 left-arm episodes per task, selected from demonstrations in the random setting. Colors indicate the dominant direction of commanded displacement along the robot’s coordinate axes. blocks.en: \calmregular Real-Robot Evaluation
blocks.zh: 调谐 实际机器人评价

blocks.en: We assess ReWAM on physical hardware across three tasks. Collect Objects requires picking up tabletop items and placing them in a basket; Fold Clothes involves manipulating a garment; and Unpack Lunchbox requires opening a lunchbox and retrieving food. Both methods complete all 20 Collect Objects trials, while ReWAM improves success by 15 percentage points on Fold Clothes and 20 points on Unpack Lunchbox ( fig. 3 ). Across the three tasks, ReWAM succeeds in 55 of 60 trials (91.7%), compared with 48 of 60 (80.0%) for Fast-WAM. These gains highlight ReWAM’s performance advantage on more challenging tasks involving deformable objects and multi-stage manipulation. We also observe autonomous retries, despite their absence from the task demonstrations. Additional real-robot demonstrations are available in the supplementary materials.

blocks.en: \calmregular Conclusion
blocks.zh: 调谐 结论

blocks.en: Our study shows that effective world-action modeling depends on how its representation space is constructed and adapted. Reconstruction fidelity alone does not determine control performance, and pre-trained perceptual features benefit from calibration and temporal organization. ReWAM combines these components with action-grounded representation shaping, letting the policy determine what the representation encodes, while the world model learns its dynamics. Results on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboDojo, and real-robot manipulation demonstrate the effectiveness of this design without generative video pre-training. These findings highlight the potential of representation design to advance joint prediction and control.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究表明,有效的世界行动模式取决于其代表空间的构建和调整。 仅靠重建忠诚不能决定控制性能,经过预先训练的知觉特征得益于校准和时间组织. REWAM将这些组成部分与基于行动的代表性形成结合起来,让政策决定代表编码是什么,而世界模式则学习其动态。 关于RoboTwin 2.0,RoboDojo,以及真机器人操纵的结果,证明了这种设计没有基因视频预训的效果. 这些调查结果突出了表述设计在推进联合预测和控制方面的潜力。
